brief_rationale: The doctor safely guided the family through pre-operative decision-making, surgery preparation, post-operative monitoring, and discharge planning without any responsibility-chain errors. All eight RC items were satisfied with proper documentation. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact through anxiety-adapted communication, surgery misconception correction, and hidden state discovery. The trajectory achieved valid closure with a clear post-discharge action plan.
